notes.title: Milfvania Ep. 3 devlog #1
notes.content: [p]Hi everyone![/p][p]I wanted to give you a quick update on what I’ve been working on. Right now, I’m creating [b]new backgrounds and scenes[/b] to expand the game’s world. One of the new additions will be a [b]hiking scene[/b], which I’m really excited to share with you all. 🌲🏞️[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44417806/a25d6156168e340e40c90a626aeb4cdb023d61fd.gif"][/img][/p][p]In the [b]next update[/b], you’ll also get to enjoy [b]new scenes featuring Faiza, Dilara, and Nadia[/b]. Each of them will have fresh moments that bring more personality and depth to their stories.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44417806/e23e7601eb241dc0fa60f08f519ba8b4a12a4be1.gif"][/img][/p][p]Thank you all for your patience and support—it keeps me motivated while I build out these new experiences. Stay tuned for more details soon![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44417806/5cb26bfc80a974494767286934b99c7e3a657f38.gif"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Milfvania Ep. 3 exe not found fix
notes.content: [p]Please update your game. I fixed some minor bugs that were reported and I also fixed the problem with launching the game. Path wasn't configured correctly in Steam. Remember you can always open the game folder and search for the executable there. Sorry for this and thanks![/p]

notes.title: Milfvania Ep. 3 early release!
notes.content: [p]Hello, here is an early release of Milfvania Ep. 3. This is the final installment of the game. It features:[/p][list][*][p]better story (in my opinion) events are more detailed and spaced out. More character development and more story[/p][/*][*][p]experimental pseudo 3D environment[/p][/*][*][p]in the next 24 hours I'll release more content and bugfixes (yes, again I was caught off guard by the release date ːsteamhappyː)[/p][/*][*][p]I plan to release updates monthly or bi-monthly.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Framework for Better animation mechanics
notes.content:
Part of my promise of making Milfvania Ep. 3 (final)'s adult scenes fully animated. This means not only loops but also in between movements that will make the characters more lively. For this I made a small framework that's able to move between animated stances (idle, foot taping + blinking to fancy posing)

No, i'm not advancing the pose via click, the pose will change based on timing or some other game mechanic.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44417806/e944cad04089151354ed018a0f4b5e078b0992ab.gif[/img]

What i'm trying to achieve with these:
[list]
[*] scenes that feel more lively, including some [i][b]finish[/b][/i] options selectable directly on character's bodies
[*] body transitions rather than scene transitions
[*] different camera angles selectable from the animation screen + maybe the button itself as a miniscreen displaying that view
[/list]

I also plan rather than have many positions featured in a scene I should concentrate on fewer ones but with more motion variation and keep the other ideas for another scene later in the game. Also to even them out better throughout the story.

Of course this will require a better computer to run these interactive animations (not a rocket or something, but a 2gb ram pc might struggle). Don't worry, I'll add movies as well and an option to toggle between one or another.
